pending: Change pending — you can undo it in the shared toast.
syncFirst: Sync this queued entry before editing or removing it.
unavailable: Changes unavailable: this entry has no valid server timestamp or is outside the seven-day window.
removeHint: The original stays in history. Undo before the toast closes to keep it.
editHint: Save creates a replacement and keeps the original in history. Undo before the toast closes to cancel.
refusal: This change is not allowed. Refresh your history.
conflict: This entry has already changed. Your history has been refreshed.
moduleDisabled: Your coach has switched this feature off. Your app is being refreshed.
mealUnknown: That meal or option is no longer available. Choose an explicit free entry or cancel.
offline: Connect to the internet to change saved history.
failed: Could not confirm the change. Your edit is kept; retry uses the same request.
